name: dsh-arabic
description: Arabic (ar) language pack for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Registers ar under Settings → General → Language, ships static translations for every UI namespace (core, skills, plugins and the third-party add-ons dsh-cron / telegram-duty / extension-hub), Arabicizes add-on sources that ship their own i18n tables — including the Telegram-facing strings of telegram-duty, dsh-telegram-channel and dsh-cron — and installs the Telegram bot command menu (the `/` list) in Arabic.
